_comment: Hand-picked wide-scene descriptions for story illustrations, keyed by story id. Generated separately from character portraits (which use Gemini via generate_character_art.py) -- this batch was originally generated on Google Colab's free-tier T4 GPU with an open-source model (SDXL + a community 'Pixar Style' LoRA, see colab_story_art_sdxl.ipynb); superseded by generate_story_art.py (Gemini) once story art switched renderers, per that script's own docstring. Not the full 324 stories yet -- this is a small first batch to validate the pipeline before committing to the rest. Rewritten a second time on 2026-09-17 after reviewing the first real Gemini batch: (1) style consistency was uneven story-to-story (some read as flatter storybook illustration rather than the intended high-production look -- addressed in generate_story_art.py's own STYLE_SUFFIX, not here), and (2) a real accuracy gap -- story_crucifixion's prompt said 'three crosses' but never actually named who was on the other two, and the model rendered only Jesus's cross alone. Every entry below was cross-checked against that story's own curated summary/characterIds in data/stories.json before being rewritten, not just reworded for detail's own sake. david_and_goliath and crucifixion were also originally rewritten once already, after the first SDXL test batch (plain base, no LoRA) rendered Goliath as a sci-fi robot and the crucifixion as a monochrome stock-photo silhouette.
story_creation: The moment of creation in stages: swirling cosmic light and darkness being separated, land and sea taking shape below a forming sky, the first sun and stars appearing -- God's Spirit hovering over it all as a vast, luminous presence, not a human figure
story_the_flood: Noah's massive wooden ark -- a huge rectangular timber vessel, not a curved ship's hull, per its described proportions -- floating on a vast flooded world under a breaking stormy sky, animals visible at small windows along its side, distant mountain peaks barely visible above the waterline, a single beam of light breaking through the clouds
story_feeding_the_5000: Jesus blessing five loaves of bread and two fish held up in his hands, his disciples distributing the multiplying food in baskets among a vast seated crowd of thousands -- men, women, and children -- on a grassy hillside at golden hour, more baskets of leftover bread being gathered at the edges of the crowd
story_david_and_goliath: a young shepherd boy, David, small and wearing simple clothing with no armor and no sword, facing Goliath, a towering nine-foot-tall Philistine giant who IS fully human (not a robot or machine) wearing bronze scale armor, a bronze helmet, and carrying a massive spear and shield, across the battlefield of the valley of Elah, a sling raised in David's hand mid-swing, both armies watching tensely from opposing hillsides
story_crucifixion: three crosses on a hill outside Jerusalem at dusk: Jesus on the center cross, and two other condemned criminals crucified on two separate, slightly shorter crosses -- one clearly positioned to his left and one to his right, all three crosses visible side by side in the same wide shot -- warm dramatic sunset light illuminating the mourners' faces and clothing in full color (not pure black silhouettes), a small group of mourners gathered at a respectful distance below Jesus's cross specifically, a darkened stormy sky overhead
story_lions_den: Daniel, his face clearly lit and visible, standing calm and unharmed among several realistic lions (not dogs or other animals) in a torchlit stone den with a single high opening in the ceiling above, King Darius and his soldiers peering down anxiously through that opening at dawn
story_the_fall: Adam and Eve standing beneath the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil in the lush Garden of Eden, a serpent coiled in its branches, Eve holding a piece of fruit -- both figures modestly concealed by garden foliage, soft shadow, and composition rather than shown nude, expressions of guilt and realization rather than triumph
story_tower_of_babel: a massive unfinished brick ziggurat tower rising into storm clouds on the plain of Shinar, countless tiny human figures swarming its ramps and scaffolding mid-construction, a wide aerial establishing shot with no single figure in the foreground since the text names no individual by name
story_crossing_the_red_sea: Moses standing with his staff raised on the shore, two towering walls of parted seawater on either side of a wide dry path, the Israelites -- families, flocks, and belongings -- crossing between the walls of water, Pharaoh's chariots and army visible pursuing at a distance behind them
story_burning_bush: Moses alone on rocky Mount Horeb, removing a sandal, facing a modest desert shrub engulfed in bright flame yet visibly unburned and unconsumed, dramatic golden light radiating from the fire against a barren wilderness backdrop
story_covenant_at_sinai: Moses standing partway up Mount Sinai holding two stone tablets, the mountaintop wreathed in thick dark cloud, lightning, and smoke, the vast camp of the Israelites and their tents visible spread across the plain far below
story_jonah_flees_and_the_fish: sailors on a small wooden ship straining against a violent storm, throwing cargo overboard, Jonah being cast into the churning dark sea as the storm rages around him, the massive silhouette of an enormous fish rising from the depths just beneath the waves to swallow him
story_elijah_taken_up: Elijah, an elderly bearded prophet, ascending into a swirling whirlwind inside a blazing chariot of fire drawn by fiery horses, Elisha standing on the ground below reaching upward, Elijah's mantle falling through the air toward him, the Jordan river visible nearby
story_jesus_walks_on_water: Jesus walking upright on the surface of a dark, storm-tossed sea at night, Peter having just stepped out of a small wooden fishing boat onto the water and beginning to sink, reaching toward Jesus, the other disciples gripping the boat's sides in fear, whitecaps and wind-driven spray all around
story_jesus_is_born: the infant Jesus wrapped in cloth and lying in a wooden feeding trough filled with straw inside a modest stone stable, Mary and Joseph kneeling beside him, warm lamplight, a small group of shepherds arriving at the doorway, a bright star glowing in the night sky visible through an opening above
story_the_empty_tomb: an open rock-cut tomb with its round stone door rolled away, a radiant angel seated on the stone, two women -- Mary Magdalene and the other Mary -- approaching in the pale light of early dawn, Roman guards collapsed and fainted on the ground nearby
story_cain_and_abel: Cain standing over his fallen brother Abel in an open field just after striking him, a rock still in his hand, distant twin altars of offering smoke visible behind them -- one still rising strong, the other extinguished -- Cain's face full of shock and dawning guilt rather than triumph
story_binding_of_isaac: Abraham standing over a stone altar on a rocky mountaintop, a knife raised in his hand, his son Isaac bound and lying on the wood, an angelic figure of light appearing overhead to stay his hand, a ram caught by its horns in a nearby thicket already visible in the scene
story_jacob_wrestles: Jacob locked in a physical wrestling struggle at night with a mysterious man of divine appearance beside a river ford, both figures straining against each other in the moonlight, the first light of dawn just beginning to break on the horizon
story_solomons_judgment: King Solomon seated on his throne, one arm raised commanding a soldier who holds a sword over a living infant, one woman rushing forward in anguish with her hand out to stop the blade and give up her claim to the child, the other woman standing back, both women and the court watching tensely
story_elijah_on_carmel: Elijah standing with arms raised beside a stone altar drenched in water that has just burst into a towering pillar of fire from the sky, a large crowd on Mount Carmel falling face-down on the ground in awe, the prophets of Baal and their own untouched, cold altar visible at a distance in the background
story_samson_and_delilah: Samson, his hair shorn and eyes lost, pushing apart two massive stone pillars with tremendous straining effort inside a grand pagan temple hall, the roof and upper structure beginning to collapse, a crowd of Philistines in the temple around him reacting in sudden terror
story_transfiguration: Jesus standing on a mountaintop transfigured in radiant blinding white light, his face shining, Moses and Elijah appearing beside him in conversation, Peter, James, and John kneeling below shielding their eyes in awe, a bright glowing cloud overshadowing the scene from above
story_gethsemane: Jesus kneeling alone in anguished prayer among ancient olive trees in the garden of Gethsemane at night under moonlight, Peter, James, and John visible a short distance away, asleep on the ground instead of keeping watch
story_pentecost: a group of disciples gathered indoors with small individual flames like tongues of fire resting above each of their heads, a visible rush of wind effect swirling papers and cloth around them, warm light filling the room, Peter standing among them mid-speech with his hand raised toward a crowd gathering at the open doorway
story_pauls_conversion: Saul thrown to the ground on a dusty road outside the walls of Damascus, shielding his eyes from an overwhelming blinding light beaming down from the sky, his traveling companions scattering and cowering around him in shock, their fallen horses and satchels scattered on the ground
